definitions.explanation: The traditional art of writing characters with brush and ink, emphasizing beauty and artistic expression.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{書道|しょどう}の{先生|せんせい}です。
examples.english: My grandmother is a calligraphy teacher.

examples.japanese: {書道|しょどう}は{日本|にほん}の{伝統|でんとう}{文化|ぶんか}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: Calligraphy is one of Japan's traditional cultures.

examples.japanese: {書道|しょどう}{展|てん}で{入賞|にゅうしょう}した。
examples.english: I won a prize at the calligraphy exhibition.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{書道|しょどう} is one of the traditional Japanese arts, along with {茶道|さどう} (tea ceremony) and {華道|かどう} (flower arrangement). The "道" (way/path) indicates it is considered a discipline for personal cultivation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{習字|しゅうじ} - penmanship, learning to write (school subject focus)
・{書道|しょどう} - calligraphy as art form (artistic focus)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{書道|しょどう}を{習|なら}う (to learn calligraphy)
・{書道|しょどう}{家|か} (calligrapher)
・{書道|しょどう}{展|てん} (calligraphy exhibition)
・{書道|しょどう}{教室|きょうしつ} (calligraphy class)

[Register: Neutral to Formal]
